name: mcp-lrclib
description: MCP server for LRCLIB. Search tracks and fetch plain or time-synced (LRC) lyrics. No API key required.
long_description: Search LRCLIB for a track and read its lyrics, plain or time-synced (LRC). No API key, no account.

tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Find a track by title, artist or album.

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: Read one track's metadata by id.

tools.name: get_lyrics
tools.description: Read a track's lyrics, plain or time-synced.
